newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weak, Russians sag.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weak, Russians sag.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was weaker on Friday after Thursday's late sell-off in futures markets, traders said.
A trader who bought a low-water M-100 cargo on Thursday at around $119/$120 cif NWE was heard trying to sell it again on Friday a couple of dollars lower than the purchase price.

Rumours of imminent increases in Russian export taxes continued to swirl, but many thought political uncertainty in Russia, with President Boris Yeltsin facing a heart operation, may delay any announcement.
